metadata.summary: High-z propagation delay prediction not supported for this model (missing wave-speed or stiffness API).
metadata.explanation: The high-z delay curve shows how elastic-wave speed affects photon travel time from early epochs. PBUF predicts an accumulated delay relative to ΛCDM because c_eff was lower in the hotter early medium. Detection of systematic timing offsets at high redshift would support the elastic propagation model.
